items.text: the founders club sheet opens in one second: the graphics fade back, then the sheet comes into focus with a slight lift. A tap outside it closes it
on a computer, the founders club sheet opens in the middle of the window, not at the top
on a computer, the pin at the foot of the index is the same round pin as the sections', inside a pane: it keeps the whole index open
Founders Club is a full section on every device: the thick rule, hide, keep and move, in the place you left it. It was drawn a moment after the index was set up and stayed bare.
the founding pack's section is now called Founders Club, with a bolt for Current, like every other section's icon.
in View, pause is now still / move, with its own icons (three particles at rest; a particle with its trail), so it no longer reads like the presets' play/pause
on a computer, the caret over a bar button opens its drawer: click it, or rest on it for a moment

Touchable sound. Your touch plays the sound as it moves the field: Fader (drag faster, the music comes up), Sweep (finger height opens a filter), Pan (the sound follows your finger), Wash (hold still for reverb), Tide (your drag plays the bytebeat). Up to two at once, from the touch button on the sound shelf or the new Touch tab
